<function name="GetWeapon" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the inflicting weapon of the damage event, if there is any.

This is not necessarily a <page>Weapon</page> entity, but it is very likely to be one.

See <page>CTakeDamageInfo:GetInflictor</page> for the actual entity that did the damage.
	</description>
	<added>2025.01.15</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Entity">The damage-inflicting weapon or <page>NULL</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
